newsitem.title: NORWAY: Transocean wins $61 mln NOK deal.
newsitem.headline: Transocean wins $61 mln NOK deal.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc. said on Wednesday its Norwegian subsidiary, Transocean ASA, had won a two-year extension of a platform drilling contract on the North Sea Gullfaks platform worth $61 million.

A statement to the Oslo Bourse said that Transocean ASA had been notified by Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) that it would exercise an option which would extend the contract from April 1, 1997 to April 1, 1999.
"Total revenues associated with the two-year extension are estimated at $61 million," it said.
